svg.text: Prefix with role name to avoid collisions
+ Add changed_when: false to read-only cmds
- Never use shell: for tasks modules can do
+ Separate vars from vault (vars ref vault)
- Never use plaintext for any credential
+ Prefix all variables with role name: nginx_port
+ Use meta/main.yml to declare role dependencies
+ Include molecule/ tests in every role
- Don't put secrets in roles - pass from inventory
Publish reusable roles to Ansible Galaxy
Golden rule: if it is not tested it is broken. Run molecule in CI. Use --check in staging pipeline before production apply.
